rules.copyForClaude: Copy to edit in Claude Code

rules.approvedNote: Approved: not in effect yet. “Publish” applies it to the engine.

approve.title: Approve batch
approve.body: You will sign the approval with your name. Then you can review the dry run and apply to ACC.

approve.passkeyHint: When you confirm, Windows Hello (or your passkey) will ask for your PIN or biometrics to sign the approval.

passkey.title: Approval passkey
passkey.intro: Approvals on real ACC are signed with a passkey (Windows Hello). Register at least one on this computer.
passkey.firstSteps: 1. In your own terminal run: npm run coordinator -- passkey-enroll  ·  2. Copy the 10-character code (valid for 10 minutes, once)  ·  3. Enter it here and confirm with Windows Hello.
passkey.stepUpSteps: First confirm with an already registered passkey; then register the new one.
passkey.label: Passkey name
passkey.notInFixtures: In fixtures mode approvals are demo approvals and need no passkey.

errors.not_supported: This browser does not support passkeys (WebAuthn). Use an up-to-date Edge or Chrome.
errors.wrong_host: You opened the app on an IP address. Passkeys only work on http://localhost: replace 127.0.0.1 with localhost in the address bar.
errors.cancelled: You cancelled the Windows Hello prompt. Nothing was approved; you can try again.
errors.timeout: The confirmation timed out. Nothing was approved; try again.
errors.no_passkey: No passkeys are registered. Go to Settings → Passkey and register one with the code from npm run coordinator -- passkey-enroll.
errors.already_registered: This passkey is already registered on this computer.
errors.challenge_expired: The batch changed or the challenge expired. Confirm again to request a new one.
errors.unknown: The confirmation could not be completed: {message}

error.claude_not_found: Claude Code was not found. Install Claude Code and open a session (`claude` in a terminal).

error.timeout: The agent took too long. Try again with a narrower question.
